title: Sex-specific associations between circadian-related genes and depression in UK Biobank participants highlight links to glucose metabolism, inflammation and neuroplasticity pathways.
authors: Minbay, Mete; Khan, Ayub; Ghasemi, Ali R; Ingram, Krista K; Ay, Ahmet A
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习分析UK Biobank中昼夜节律基因SNP与抑郁的性别特异性关联，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Depressive disorders have increased in global prevalence, making improved management of these disorders a public health priority. Prior research has linked circadian clock genes to depression, either through direct interactions with mood-related pathways in the brain or by modulating the phase of circadian rhythms. Using machine learning and statistical techniques, we explored associations between 157,347 SNP variants from 51 circadian-related genes and depression scores from the patient health questionnaire 9 (PHQ-9) in 99,939 UK Biobank participants. Our results highlight multiple pathways linking the circadian system to mood, including metabolic, monoamine, immune, and stress-related pathways. Notably, genes regulating glucose metabolism and inflammation (GSK3B, LEP, RORA, and NOCT) were prominent factors in females, in addition to DELEC1 and USP46, two genes of unknown function. In contrast, FBXL3 and DRD4 emerged as significant risk factors for male depression. We also found epistatic interactions involving RORA, NFIL3, and ZBTB20 as either risk or protective factors for depression, underscoring the importance of transcription factors (ZBTB20, NFIL3) and hormone receptors (RORA) in depression etiology. Understanding the complex, sex-specific links between circadian genes and mood disorders will facilitate the development of therapeutic interventions and enhance the efficacy of multi-target treatments for depression.
abstract_zh: 抑郁症在全球范围内的患病率不断上升，使得改善这些障碍的管理成为公共卫生优先事项。先前的研究已将生物钟基因与抑郁症联系起来，无论是通过与大脑中情绪相关通路的直接相互作用，还是通过调节昼夜节律的相位。利用机器学习和统计技术，我们探讨了来自51个昼夜节律相关基因的157,347个SNP变异与99,939名英国生物银行参与者的患者健康问卷9（PHQ-9）抑郁评分之间的关联。我们的结果突出了连接昼夜节律系统与情绪的多种通路，包括代谢、单胺、免疫和应激相关通路。值得注意的是，调节葡萄糖代谢和炎症的基因（GSK3B、LEP、RORA和NOCT）在女性中是显著因素，此外还有DELEC1和USP46，这两个功能未知的基因。相比之下，FBXL3和DRD4成为男性抑郁症的显著风险因素。我们还发现了涉及RORA、NFIL3和ZBTB20的上位性相互作用，作为抑郁症的风险或保护因素，强调了转录因子（ZBTB20、NFIL3）和激素受体（RORA）在抑郁症病因学中的重要性。理解昼夜节律基因与情绪障碍之间复杂、性别特异性的联系，将有助于开发治疗干预措施，并增强抑郁症多靶点治疗的有效性。
